items.lang|greatsage|gamerule.announcementsReq: Skill announcements, ceremonies and evolutions only play for players who have the Unique Skill Great Sage. Off (default): everyone gets them. This does not give access to the menu: see requireGreatSage.

items.lang|greatsage|gamerule.sageShaderRender: On: the menu and every announcement (skills, evolutions, Demon Lord, Harvest Festival...) are drawn by shaders. Off: the classic menu and announcements. Both say and do the same things.
Great Sage starts limited and grows: only intrinsic and common skills can be analysed until you open the rest. Turn this off to have everything unlocked from the start, the way it worked before.

items.lang|greatsage|greatsage.scene.draw_hint: Enter to validate · Right-click to undo a stroke
On by default. The Sage's console replaces the menu and every announce is redrawn. /gamerule sageShaderRendering false brings back the classic look.
Harvest Festival, Demon Lord Seed, Hero Egg, True Hero and the True Demon Lord awakening are now full-screen scenes with their own ambience. Nothing can hurt or push you while they play.
Rebuilt shot by shot from episode 35.
A new reincarnation scene: draw your wishes above a lake of souls under the stars.
When skills merge into a Unique or an Ultimate, they slam into your screen as anime skill cards, the screen shatters, and the shards come back together as the new skill.

Name a monster and the camera pulls to the side: your magicules flow into it and it lights up as it absorbs them. Then the Sage reports the name, and the Voice of the World confirms its evolution. Players who get named see it from their side. Turn it off with namingScene in the client config.

With the Great Sage or Thought Acceleration, press H or say it: the world freezes into cold colors, sounds drag down, your heartbeat takes over and incoming projectiles show their path, red if it hits you. Solo: the whole world slows x5. Multiplayer: a 20-block bubble slows creatures and projectiles. 6 s, 40 s cooldown, both configurable.

With a sense skill such as Magic Sense, see the aura of every being, shaped like its body. Its color follows its alignment (violet Majin, white-gold Hero, red Chaos, green neutral), its size follows its EP and keeps growing: a massive aura in the distance means run. Tune it in Settings.
Experience gains x1.5, the first kill of a species counts as observing it, and items you hold for the first time are appraised.
Skills that keep modes sealed (Sloth, Black Lightning...) open them when the Sage analyses them. FoxAblaze Ultimate's Raphael counts as the Sage.

needGreatSage is now announcementsRequireGreatSage: it only decides who gets the announcements. New: requireGreatSage (on by default). Turn it off and everyone can use the G menu, assess, voice commands and analyses without the Great Sage skill.
Bigger buttons, the Sage's bubble no longer covers the pages, and a sealed class tells you to open it in the Growth tree.

Reincarnation no longer hands out special addon Uniques, and addon resistances are no longer always Nuclear or Void. Assess bubbles no longer drift when flying, auras no longer get stuck in a capsule shape with some mods, and the freeze before animations is gone. Server admins get /greatsage xp. Voice commands now work with microphones that refuse 16 kHz, and the menu's background hum is much quieter. The Portuguese and Turkish voice models install properly, menu text no longer shows through confirmation windows, a full reset now gives every Unique Tensura owes you from the reset counter, and you no longer stay invulnerable after a rare reincarnation outcome.
